Set to return from quad injury after missing five games since Week 3; practiced Thursday and Friday.
Emerged as lead back during Hall's absence; now likely shares backfield with returning Hall.
Expected to take on larger role with Wilson out; Jets WR room thin behind him.
Named alongside Mitchell as needing to step up with Garrett Wilson out.
Ankle; limited Wednesday, full Thursday and Friday, no game-status designation for Sunday.
Hamstring/knee; limited Wednesday, full Thursday and Friday, no designation on final report.
New hip injury limited him Wednesday; upgraded to full participant Thursday, off final report.
Limited participant Wednesday with a rib injury; still practicing, expected to play.

Did not practice Wednesday; non-participation trends toward missing this game.
Listed with a groin issue but was a full participant Wednesday.
Monken announced Sanders starts vs. Saints, his first start of 2026; took all first-team reps this week.
Remains in concussion protocol; limited Friday, listed questionable, not cleared, may not even back up.
Ruled out on final injury report with shoulder injury and concussion; DNP Thursday.
Back/rest issue; no final designation, reported good to go after limited Thursday practice.
Added Thursday with groin (limited); final report lists only Collins out and Watson questionable for CLE.
Calf; limited both Wednesday and Thursday, no final game-status designation reported.

Benched in favor of Joe Milton; also questionable with rib injury, possibly emergency third QB.
Downgraded to doubtful; missed fourth straight practice Friday with hamstring injury.
Primary back if Skattebo sits; Tyrone Tracy on IR, only Gregory Desrosiers behind him on 53.
No game status on final report after limited Thu/Fri (hamstring/back); expected to play vs former club.
Practiced Friday after missing Thursday; Harbaugh said health is not an issue for Sunday.
Questionable with hand injury; limited in Friday practice.
Full participant all week (knee); no game status on final injury report.
Not listed on Friday's final Eagles injury report; took bulk of RB snaps vs Commanders.
DNP Wednesday and Thursday with foot injury suffered vs 49ers; trending toward missing Sunday.
Limited Thursday with shoulder injury after not practicing Wednesday.
New addition Thursday as limited with calf injury, apparently suffered in Wednesday practice.
New knee injury listed on Thursday participation report.
Full participant Thursday; still listed with Week 2 elbow dislocation but practicing without limits.
Listed Out on Illinois' initial Big Ten availability report; still has not debuted this season.
Questionable on Tuesday's availability report after missing the Washington game; a starting-caliber lineman.
Listed as SMU's starting quarterback for Friday's game vs Virginia Tech; no injury designation.
Ruled out (undisclosed) per ACC availability report; removes a WR from SMU's rotation, boosting targets for Cooper/Knight/Greene group.

Questionable on ACC availability report; VT also lists WRs Chanz Wiggins and Luke Stuewe questionable.
